newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian zinc falls, other metals steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian zinc falls, other metals steady.

text.p: Zinc prices were subdued on Wednesday on poor industrial demand while other metals held steady in sluggish trade, dealers said.
Zinc lost 50 rupees to 8,050 rupees per quintal (100 kg). Tin was unchanged at 30,900 rupees per quintal. Tin fell 300 rupees per quintal on Monday.
Nickel was steady at 36,300 rupees per quintal. Copper and aluminium were unchanged at 13,750 rupees per quintal and 7,700 rupees per quintal respectively.
Bombay Metals Exchange president Sharad Parikh said the market was expected to improve in the next few days.
